date_note: Day Adire's notice confirmed the leak and its scope; the contractor's server was accessed on Nov 12 per the notice.
title: Adire Law Office: an approximate count of 1,828 cases of personal data leaked via contractor's email delivery service
summary: Adire Law Office says its contractor's email delivery service Mail Shonin (メール商人), run by EMZ, was accessed by a third party on Nov 12 and some stored information was taken. Cybersecurity.com (Japan), relaying Adire's Nov 25 notice, gives an approximate count of 1,828 cases of data from website form inquiries made from Jan 1, 2023 to Nov 11, 2026. Adire says its own systems were not accessed.
plain: A Japanese law firm says a hack at an email service it used exposed an approximate count of 1,828 cases of data from website inquiries. It says its own systems were not accessed and card and bank details are not included.
exec: The leak came from a supplier, not from the firm's own systems, according to Adire's notice.
action: Adire advises being wary of suspicious emails, SMS or calls claiming to be from the firm or its lawyers, and not opening URLs or attachments or entering personal data or passwords.

validation.note: Adire's own notice (official.adire.jp pressroom, Nov 25) was read, but its URL is rejected by the build as a listing page; the facts are cited to Cybersecurity.com (Japan), which relays it.
